routes.label: the salt oval
routes.notes: B_LAKEBED: the short salt oval, inside the burrow points at x +-20.

routes.label: the lab's long hall
routes.notes: F_LAB (y -6): the hall loop south of the pillar rows at z 105 and z 112, east of the hatch ramp (x < -61).
